audits.notes:
CANONICAL-SOURCE FINDING (load-bearing): the persona/synthesizer pins exist in BOTH files, but they are not co-equal. packages/cli/src/commands/config-split.ts proves agentchat.yaml's review_personas / planner_personas / review_synthesizer / plan_synthesizer are LEGACY and are migrated INTO routing.yaml as personas + workloads.{review_adversarial,plan_refine}. packages/config/src/files/routing.ts (lines 41-59) owns the live schema and validates that every workloads.*.eligible_agents key resolves to routing.yaml personas.<key>.preferred_agent. So the LIVE pins to optimize are the routing.yaml ones; the agentchat copies have DIVERGED (e.g. review naming_clarity: routing->claude-acp-sonnet [ACP] vs agentchat->oc-deepseek-v4-flash [CLI]) and should be treated as dead/confirm-and-delete, not as swap targets.

NET NEW vs the already-established known candidate: the established opportunity is exactly the routing.yaml review_adversarial (8) + plan_refine (5) persona fan-out = 13 ACP-pinned tool-free dispatches (rows 1-2). My audit confirms 13/13 of those resolve to stdio-acp (codex-acp-deep x4, claude-acp-sonnet x4, gemini-acp-pro x4, + plan adds claude-acp-sonnet/codex-acp-deep/gemini-acp-pro) — i.e. the '11/13 pinned to stdio-acp' figure in the brief is actually 13/13 under the CANONICAL routing.yaml pins (the 11/13 likely came from counting the diverged agentchat copies where naming_clarity+simplicity landed on CLI agents). Worth reconciling that count.

NO genuinely-new ACP-only tool-free site exists beyond those 13. Everything else is either: (a) already CLI / openai-compat-http (synthesizer pools, default_roles planner/executor/reviewer-gemini, oc-* reviewers) so no cold-start to remove; (b) ACP but TOOL-USING (home-mgmt, task-refiner-*, oc-deepseek-v4-pro agentic reviewer) so warm-pool not CLI-swap; (c) legacy/dead duplicate pins (agentchat personas + synthesizers); or (d) off the fleet path entirely (CC adversarial-plan-topic in-process subagents).

SECONDARY ACTIONS (not latency levers but config hygiene surfaced by the audit): 
1. default_roles.reviewer conflict — routing.yaml says 'gemini' (gemini-cli), agentchat.yaml says 'oc-deepseek-v4-pro' (opencode-cli agentic). Determine precedence; both are already CLI so neither is a cold-start win, but the divergence affects which agent fields role-routed reviews.
2. thoughts.analyze digest/signals pin 'local-gemma26' is a dangling agent name (not in the agents list) — fix or it silently no-ops the thought-analysis digest.
3. If you DO cli-swap the 13 persona pins, the swap target should be a tool-free CLI/HTTP reasoner per lens (e.g. register claude-cli pinned to a model, codex-cli, or repoint to gemini-cli / a local openai-compat reasoner) — exactly the 'register new CLI agent' lever you flagged; the existing CLI synthesizer pool (claude/codex/gemini/gemini-cli-3-5-flash) is a ready template for the persona-draft pool too.

audits.notes:
Coverage: the plugin/workflows tree contains exactly 3 workflow.ts files (adversarial-review, adversarial-plan, memory-digest) plus _shared helpers (io.ts, pool-resolver.ts) and *.test.ts. A scoped ripgrep over the dir (excluding tests) found exactly 4 ctx.dispatch + 4 ctx.awaitChain sites, ALL in the two adversarial workflows. There are NO hidden judge/critic/refiner/repair dispatch sites in these workflows — the only roles are persona fan-out + synthesizer in each.

CLI-swap candidates found (the cli-swap rows above): the adversarial-review 8-persona fan-out (workflow.ts:539) and the adversarial-plan 5-persona fan-out (workflow.ts:392). This corroborates the KNOWN dominant opportunity in the brief.

Correction to the brief's '11/13 pinned to stdio-acp': the CURRENT routing.yaml (mtime 2026-06-04 23:27) pins ALL 13 personas to stdio-acp (review: 5x claude-acp-sonnet/gemini-acp-pro/codex-acp-deep mix across 8; plan: claude-acp-sonnet x2, codex-acp-deep x2, gemini-acp-pro x1). None of the 13 personas is on a CLI adapter today — so 13/13 are ACP-paying cold-start, not 11/13. Worth re-confirming against whatever snapshot produced the 11/13 figure; the config may have drifted toward more ACP since.

Tool-free verdict is robust for all personas: both workflows pass use_worktree:false, inline the review diff / plan spec into the rendered prompt, and the HOST workflow (not the dispatched agent) performs every ctx.fileWrite. Review personas are explicitly told to ignore worktree git; plan personas get topic+spec inline. So a claude-cli/codex-cli/gemini-cli swap (or a newly registered CLI agent, e.g. claude-cli->opus for architect/risk, codex-cli for simplifier/maintainability, gemini-cli for integration/performance) would preserve behavior while shedding the ACP cold-start.

Recommended implementation shape (no new code needed in the workflows): repoint personas.<key>.preferred_agent in routing.yaml from the *-acp-* adapter to the equivalent CLI agent, OR register new CLI agents in agents.yaml pinned to the desired model and point the personas at them. The workflow reads preferred_agent verbatim (review:541 / plan:394 ctx.dispatch agent: persona.preferred_agent) and never special-cases ACP, so the swap is purely config. The synthesizer pools already model the desired end-state (CLI pool resolved via pickFromPool) and can serve as the template for converting personas to CLI pools if per-persona pooling is wanted.

No memory-digest action: it dispatches nothing.

audits.notes:
HEADLINE: No new CLI-swap candidates on the daemon side. The CLI-swap lever applies only to dispatches that are (a) tool-free AND (b) currently paying the ACP cold-start. Every TOOL-FREE daemon dispatch (brief-synthesizer, dreaming-judge-pool, t2-judge-pool, query-rewriter) already bypasses ACP entirely — they are direct local OpenAI-compat HTTP POSTs (fetch -> /v1/chat/completions) against agents on adapter: openai-compat-http, NOT stdio-acp. So they pay ZERO cold-start; there is nothing to swap. Conversely, every TOOL-USING daemon dispatch (orchestrate-one-task / plan-runtime leaf tasks, long-lived ticks) goes through chainStartInternal and CAN land on an ACP adapter, but is multi-turn worktree/MCP work -> warm-pool territory, explicitly excluded from CLI-swap per the established lever.

MECHANISM: The daemon has TWO distinct dispatch mechanisms. (1) In-process local-HTTP completion pools (brief-synth, both judge pools, rewriter) — selected by ROLE via agentchat.yaml roles[] (brief-synthesizer / dreaming-judge / memory-refiner), round-robin, single-turn, json_object, no ACP. Confirmed in agentchat.yaml: those roles are all on openai-compat-http (granite-3b local+mac-mini, qwen 35B/8b). (2) chainStartInternal (routes/chains.ts -> resolveInitialRoute/routeAgent) — the agentic worker path used by orchestrate-reactor, plan-runtime, and long-lived ticks; this is where ACP adapters (claude-acp-sonnet, codex-acp-*, gemini-acp-pro) get used, and it's all tool-using.

CONTROL POINT for those local pools: NOT a preferred_agent pin — it's the role tag + agentchat roles[] membership, overridable via env (PENUMBRA_DREAMING_JUDGE_ROLE, PENUMBRA_JUDGE_ROLE, PENUMBRA_DREAMING_BRIEF_SYNTHESIZER_ROLE) and the rewriter's rewriterBaseUrl/rewriterModel config keys. If you ever wanted to point a daemon judge/synth at a CLI/ACP agent it would REGRESS latency (adds cold-start to a path that has none); the optimization is already optimal there.

The ONE non-obvious item worth flagging for the parent, recommendation=keep but verify: plan-runtime/orchestrate dispatch agent is fully plan-authored (allow_agents = preferred_agent + fallback_agent from each task's yaml meta). If any plan pins a TOOL-FREE task (e.g. a pure synthesis/refine leaf) to an ACP agent, THAT individual task would be a CLI candidate — but that's a per-plan authoring issue, not a daemon code site. The known adversarial persona fan-out (already found) is the real instance of that pattern. content-quality-judge, reconciler-sweep, long-lived/reconciler, and the StubJudgePool are NON-sites (no LLM dispatch) and are listed only to close them out.

audits.notes:
Bottom line: across packages/{mcp,core,agentchat}/src, the ONLY internal programmatic fixed-agent dispatch that initiates through the chain_start/ACP fleet lifecycle (and is tool-free reasoning) is the worker THOUGHT-ANALYZER — two sub-paths: digest (summarize) and signals (classify/extract). Both feed content INLINE, are single-shot, and tell the model nothing about reading files. They are the genuinely-new candidate this audit surfaces.

CRITICAL CAVEAT on the thought-analyzer: its agent is config-driven (agentchat thoughts.analyze.digest.agent / .signals.agent) and the CODE DEFAULT is 'local-gemma26' — a LOCAL model that does NOT go through ACP, so by default it pays no ACP cold-start. It is only an ACP cold-start victim IF a runtime config pins analyze.*.agent to an stdio-acp agent. I could not find the runtime value: the real config is not the repo agentchat.yaml (that's a mock mock-agent.sh stub) nor any checked-in yaml — it lives in the operator's runtime config. ACTION: verify the live thoughts.analyze.{digest,signals}.agent value before treating this as a cold-start opportunity. If it's already 'local-gemma26' (or any llamactl-served local), it's optimal as-is (keep). If it's pinned to e.g. claude-acp-sonnet/gemini-acp-pro/codex-acp-*, then swap to the CLI sibling (claude-cli/gemini-cli/codex-cli) or to the local judge model — exactly the same lever as the persona fan-out. The signals path fans out one dispatch per signal definition, so the multiplier there is the bigger win.

IMPORTANT ARCHITECTURAL FINDING: penumbra already has a SECOND, ACP-free transport for tool-free reasoning — JudgeChatFn (packages/core/src/services/judge-chat.ts), a direct POST to 127.0.0.1:7944/v1/chat/completions (llamactl local proxy, default model 'local', 30s timeout). The refiner (dispatch-prompt-refiner) and the memory-efficacy classifier already use it, so they pay ZERO ACP cold-start. This suggests the cleanest fix for the thought-analyzer (and any future inline-reasoning site) is NOT to register yet another CLI agent, but to route it through JudgeChatFn like the refiner/classifier already do — collapsing summarize/classify/refine onto one local-HTTP completion path instead of the chain_start lifecycle. Worth flagging to the plan: 'prefer JudgeChat (local /v1/chat/completions) for inline single-shot reasoning; reserve chain_start/CLI-swap for multi-turn or agent-pool reasoning like the adversarial personas.'

Nothing else in mcp/core/agentchat src is a hidden tool-free reasoning ACP dispatch: stumble-extractor is pure SQL/text extraction (no LLM), autocommit uses git directly, the dispatcher and silent-failure-retry are tool-using coding paths, and the MCP chain-start* tools just forward the user's chosen agent. brainstorm delegates to a daemon workflow (out of scope here — audit that workflow definition in the daemon package separately).
